about: Pure-Ergo budget and opcount admission, reservation, configuration, and perf counter decoding guards.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-budget-admit-cores-only
mutants.rule: Budget admission must check both core width and reserved memory capacity.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-budget-cap-unknown-at-default
mutants.rule: Unmeasured commands reserve the default charge without setting a hard memory cap.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-budget-gate-load-admitted
mutants.rule: Budget config parsing must refuse non-zero removed gate-load directives.

mutants.name: selfhost-toolchain-budget-opcount-multiplexed
mutants.rule: Multiplexed hardware counters with running < enabled must be refused rather than returning scaled values.
